title: Translate internal service failures to fixed privacy-safe client errors
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md, docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md and the task sourceRefs before editing. This is an independent leaf in the B001–B100 cohort, not an integration or completed feature claim. Implement only the owned source and tests, using the exact pinned API section in PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS. No imports from unmerged A/B modules, no manifests/barrels/App.tsx/shared task metadata edits and no new dependencies. Locally declare the contract's shared structural types; package engine/protocol production stays ES2022-only and pure, with no Firebase, browser, Node, UI, credentials, wall clock or global randomness. Use existing deterministic engine RNG only where the contract permits. Never turn a trusted verifier input into a claim of cryptographic verification. Unspecified rules remain explicit named decision-required results; no worker invents policies. Preserve existing T01–T10 API/tests. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests, then node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full. Return a handoff with paths, API, actual checks, benchmark receipt references and limitations. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, deployment, credential access, task-issue mutation or budget changes. Implement publicServiceError exactly as frozen in section B081 of docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md. Whitelist exact internal string categories: invalid-input→invalid-request,false; stale→retry,true; all other/unknown/forbidden/missing-room/wrong-passcode/internal/provider errors→unavailable,false. Do not copy message, stack, object fields or submitted values; never call arbitrary toString/getters. The same unavailable response conceals whether a private room or credential exists.
acceptance: Missing room, bad passcode and forbidden identity produce byte-equivalent unavailable responses.
Exact stale and invalid-input map to the declared retry/validation categories.
Error objects, accessor/proxy objects, strings containing private material and arbitrary primitives produce fixed responses without inspection or leaks.
The exported implementation matches the frozen local structural API, preserves legacy APIs, and changes only declared ownership; no unresolved rule is silently decided.

Scoped lint, typecheck and meaningful tests pass, followed by node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; handoff records actual outcomes and receipt references without claiming App/provider integration.
